prompt: Name one of the twelve Olympian gods of Greek myth.

answers.name: Zeus
answers.fact: King of the gods, and the only one who threw the thunderbolt.

answers.name: Poseidon
answers.fact: Drew the sea when the three brothers divided the world by lot.

answers.name: Apollo
answers.fact: Music, prophecy and plague, and the only major god the Romans did not rename.

answers.name: Athena
answers.fact: Born fully armoured from Zeus's head. Athens is named for her.

answers.name: Aphrodite
answers.fact: Born from sea foam, and married off to Hephaestus against her will.

answers.name: Ares
answers.fact: God of war, and the least liked of the twelve by the Greeks themselves.

answers.name: Hermes
answers.fact: Messenger, trickster, and the god who walked the dead to the underworld.

answers.name: Artemis
answers.fact: Apollo's twin. Goddess of the hunt, sworn never to marry.

answers.name: Hera
answers.fact: Queen of the gods, and occupied in most myths with punishing Zeus's affairs.

answers.name: Hephaestus
answers.fact: The smith god, thrown from Olympus as an infant and lamed by the fall.

answers.name: Demeter
answers.fact: Goddess of the harvest, whose grief for Persephone made winter.

answers.name: Dionysus
answers.fact: Wine and theatre. The last to join, and the only one with a mortal mother.

extras.name: Hestia
extras.fact: The disputed twelfth. Some lists have her in place of Dionysus - she gave up her seat.

extras.name: Hades
extras.fact: Ruled the underworld, and so was never counted among the Olympians.

extras.name: Persephone
extras.fact: Queen of the underworld rather than an Olympian.

extras.name: Eros
extras.fact: A god of love, but not one of the twelve.

extras.name: Pan
extras.fact: A rustic god of the wild, never an Olympian.

extras.name: Helios
extras.fact: The sun, and a Titan rather than an Olympian.

extras.name: Asclepius
extras.fact: God of medicine, and a son of Apollo rather than one of the twelve.
